NURSING NOTE - ONCOLOGY NURSE NAVIGATION INTAKE Date: 03/14/71 Time 10:05 RN: Beatrix Lindqvist, RN Pt: Jonas Abbey / Yonas Tesfaye (alias on old record) 70 y/o male Rm Infusion 3 MRN 7710-4426
S: Pt came with wife Selam Abbey and daughter Lidya Abbey. Pt state "I am 69" (chart 70), says born 1999. Wife correct him: born June 2000. He deny any heart problem though chart show ischemic heart disease since 2062 and he take metoprolol, clopidogrel, simvastatin... says he stopped "the little pills" himself. Pt says he never drink alcohol, wife say he drank in 2059-2062. Wife tells us he work before at Northfield Cold Storage as forklift operator until 2064. Now not working. Lives with wife and son Henok Abbey at 7 Larkspur Terrace, Saint Paul. Sponsor family friend Gwen Ostrander from Grace Lutheran Church drive them. Phone for scheduling 651-555-0172. O: BP 118/74, pulse 66, afebrile. Wt 88 kg. Walks independent. Pain 2/10 abdomen. Rich diet low in fiber at home, pt say. A: new colon cancer, teaching about colonoscopy result and staging done. Pt anxious. Asked about port and chemo "Eloxatin". Explained doctor will decide. P: Pt to see Dr Hryshko on the 21st. Navigator Dana Rich to call. Written teaching given. Appt reminder card: Mr Abbey 3/21 09:30. Resettlement paperwork pasted from scan: "Case RC-42-31209 Name: Yonas Abebe Tesfaye DOB 17/06/2000 arrival 05 JUN 2042"
